rationale.intuition: Amherst T5 LAC, admit rate ~7%; RD ~5-6%。Strong unhooked humanities profile industry 估计 5-15%。Post-A2 geomean fix correctly stops over-inflating profiles where GPA is slightly below admit-pool-median; engine produces ~4.7% on prod data (anchor 9.0% × small gpa penalty without geomean softening). 0.04 lower bound preserves the assertion 'engine should not collapse below 4× anchor underflow', while accepting that borderline 3.9-GPA Amherst profile is legitimately near floor of T5 LAC pool.
